title: Murmur artifact index, schema 2
description: The artifacts-index.json a Murmur artifact source publishes: every version it serves of every artifact. Written by `mur index`; read by `mur search`. Sorting and the agreement between an asset's file name and its artifact, version and platform are checked by mur and are not expressible here.

scope.description: The scope every artifact in the index is named under. Never `local`.

artifacts.description: Sorted by name in byte order; names are unique.

part.description: One part of an artifact name: lowercase ASCII letters, digits and `-`, not starting or ending with `-`, at most 100 characters.

name.description: The bare name packed in the artifact's murmur.yaml.

runtime.description: The packed `runtime:` of the newest version.

description.description: The first sentence of the newest version's packed `description:`.

versions.description: Newest first by semver precedence; versions are unique.

release.description: The release tag whose assets hold this version's files.

built_at_level.description: The WIT level the version was built at: the value its files pack in murmur-build.json, else the newest level its interfaces fit. Absent when they fit no level.

interfaces.description: Every `murmur:` interface the version's component exports or imports, sorted and unique.

assets.description: Sorted by file; one per payload file.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file's bytes, as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
